name: tune_heads
description: Tune: models to fine-tune; auto = RT, plus CCS when the report has enough ion-mobility data

name: tune_predict_sessions
description: Tune: ONNX Runtime sessions for the re-prediction; 0 = -threads

name: tune_keep_free_cysteine_offset
description: Tune: keep the free-cysteine RT offset when re-predicting with the tuned RT model (off: the offset was fitted to the stock model, and a model tuned on the run has learned the effect)

name: filter:q_value
description: Precursor q-value cut-off of the training set

name: filter:min_charge
description: CCS: lowest precursor charge (RT pools all charges; z1 is censored at the ramp top on timsTOF)

name: filter:allow_z1
description: CCS: permit filter:min_charge 1 (censored observations then train)

name: filter:rt_spread_max
description: Drop a sequence whose charge states' RTs span more than this (minutes)

name: filter:rt_max_minutes
description: RT normalisation; 0 = the run's latest observed RT

name: cohort:train_size
description: Training units (sequences for RT, sequence x charge for CCS); 0 = the whole pool

name: cohort:train_frac
description: Instead of train_size: the fraction of the pool

name: cohort:full_fit
description: Train on every unit of the run, test and validation included: validation and test are then in-sample, so judge the result on a different run

name: cohort:no_inner_val
description: No inner validation cohort: its units rejoin the pool and checkpoints are selected on the test cohort, which is then no longer held out

name: train:epochs
description: Length of the cosine schedule (and the most epochs)

name: train:warmup
description: Linear warm-up epochs

name: train:lr
description: Peak learning rate (Adam)

name: train:batch_size
description: Batch size within a length group

name: stop:eval_every
description: Validate every n epochs

name: stop:min_epochs
description: Never stop before this epoch

name: stop:patience
description: Stop after this many epochs without progress (not before max(min_epochs, warmup))

name: stop:rel_tol
description: Progress: the selection metric beats the best so far by this fraction

name: stop:abs_tol
description: Progress: ... by this absolute amount (0 = use rel_tol)

name: stop:max_seconds
description: Time budget per head, checked between epochs (the final evaluation may exceed it); 0 = none

name: stop:select
description: Selection metric on the validation cohort

name: machine:device
description: Auto: the GPU when one is usable and pays off (NVIDIA: CUDA, RT and CCS with cuDNN 9; Apple: CoreML for MS2 of large libraries, MPS for fine-tuning), else the CPU; cpu: CPU only (the reference); also cuda[:N], coreml, mps

name: machine:coreml_units
description: CoreML compute units: gpu (CPU and GPU, fastest), all (Core ML's choice, Neural Engine included), ane (CPU and Neural Engine), cpu (checks)

name: machine:train_threads
description: CPU threads for fine-tuning (0: 16 on Linux and Windows, 8 on macOS). The tuned weights depend on the count, which is recorded; 16 on a Mac reproduces a Linux model

name: machine:cores
description: MacOS: which cores -threads 0 counts: all, or performance (saves energy, not time). Does not change the output

name: machine:no_cudnn
description: CUDA fine-tuning without cuDNN (when only its loader shim is installed, as in pytorch.org's libtorch zips); slower

name: machine:seed
description: Seed of the training subsample and batch order

name: machine:tf32
description: TensorFloat-32 on NVIDIA GPUs, for prediction and fine-tuning: faster, but about 1 % of precursors select a different fragment set (off: GPU and CPU agree to float rounding)

name: machine:gpu_sessions
description: CUDA: ONNX Runtime sessions per GPU and model, each with its own stream; CoreML: concurrent batches. Does not change the output

name: machine:require_gpu
description: Fail instead of predicting on the CPU when -machine:device asks for a GPU (or auto finds one) that a model cannot use
